title: Graton Casino Expansion
summary: This note details the Graton Casino Expansion project, a $2.9M undertaking where the owner coordinated between internal teams and external stakeholders. The challenge involved balancing customer desires for premium customizations against vendor timeline concerns and internal scope creep worries. The process involved establishing weekly coordination meetings to find compromises and presenting options to the client, ultimately delivering the project on schedule with over $400k in customizations.

key_points.text: Coordinating between internal teams and external stakeholders including architects, general contractors, and global supply vendors
Vendors were pushing back on the timeline stating that this was not feasible
Internal team was worried about scope creep
Delivered the $2.9M project with over $400k in customizations on schedule
